[F012] Repo: DontPanic  
Env: dev  
Project: (none)

Overall verdict: **needs_changes**. The implementer declared the target correctly; structured target context is valid, and none of its five commands use forbidden or missing-required-flag shapes.

FINDING (high, correctness): Harness and model resolution are independent, allowing a model for one vendor to be forwarded to another vendor’s CLI. Evidence: a project override of `roles.implementer: codex` combined with global `roles.implementer: {name: claude, model: claude-opus-5}` resolves to `codex` plus `claude-opus-5`; plan-level `agents_required` can cause the same mismatch. Recommendation: resolve harness/model atomically, suppress inherited models when a higher-priority layer changes harness, and add cross-layer and plan-override regression tests.

FINDING (low, style): The newly added F012 test file fails `ruff format --check`. Recommendation: format the new test and touched files before completion.

The focused pytest suite could not initialize because the read-only sandbox has no writable temporary directory; all 28 F012 tests collected, and direct no-filesystem argv assertions passed 4/4. Ruff lint reported two pre-existing, out-of-diff violations. CodeRabbit was unavailable because CLI 0.3.2 rejected `auth status --agent` and the compatible authentication check reported “not logged in.”
